newsitem.title: UK: NWE JET TRADES FIRM, VOLUME THIN.
newsitem.headline: NWE JET TRADES FIRM, VOLUME THIN.

text.p: Northwest European jet fuel spreads were steady to firmer in thin volume on Monday, traders said.
Outright values slipped $1.50 a tonne in line with weaker IPE futures. August IPE last traded at $168.00 a tonne, down $1.50. September shed $1.25 to $169.50.
A barge of 1,600 tonnes went to a European airline around $1 firmer at September IPE +$18.50.

Cargo spreads were notionally steady at around $17 over September IPE. A 30,000 tonne cargo into the British south coast changed hands at $17.25 over September IPE on Friday. In the Med a cargo of Algerian was rumoured done at a premium of between $8 and $9 to Med fob high quotations.
